Project Overview

A Refined Identity for Everyday Comfort

PRISTA is a women's homewear and sleepwear brand operating in the Egyptian market. The project focused on developing a refined visual identity that reflects femininity, softness, and comfort through a cohesive brand language. The identity brings together an elegant logo, a considered color palette, typography, graphic elements, and a consistent visual direction.

The visual direction was created to establish a recognizable brand presence, balancing understated elegance with details inspired by sewing, craftsmanship, and the softness of fabrics.

04 / 10

Logo Concept & Exploration

The Letter P, a Needle, and a Thread — One Distinctive Mark

THE CORE IDEA
The central logo concept merges two symbolic elements into one distinctive mark. The watch represents time, precision, and attention to detail, while the glasses represent vision, perspective, and personal style. Together, they translate PRISTA's personality into a recognizable visual symbol.

The logo was built around the letter P, integrated with a sewing needle and thread. The concept connects the brand mark to craftsmanship and attention to detail while giving the letterform a distinctive visual expression. The needle represents precision and craftsmanship, while the thread reinforces the connection to sewing and garment-making. The concept was explored through hand-drawn sketches and variations before reaching the final logo.

05 / 10

Logo Design & Development

Turning a Simple Letterform into a Meaningful Brand Symbol

The Letter P

The initial letter of the brand name forms the foundation of the logo and creates an instantly recognizable starting point.

Needle & Thread

A sewing needle and flowing thread are integrated into the letterform to reference craftsmanship, precision, and garment-making.

Final Refinement

The selected direction balances the letterform, needle detail, and dashed circular outline to create a refined and distinctive symbol.

06 / 10

Logo System & Guidelines

A Consistent Logo System with Clear Usage Principles

Logo Variations

Primary logo, horizontal secondary logo, standalone icon, and black-and-white versions.

Construction & Clear Space

Geometric construction and clear-space guidance help preserve the logo's proportions, visibility, and balance.

Usage Guidelines

Minimum-size guidance and incorrect-use examples help maintain consistent and appropriate logo application.

07 / 10

Visual Identity System

A Soft, Feminine Visual Language with Refined Details

Color Palette

The palette combines a restrained neutral foundation with soft feminine accents. Primary colors are Deep Black (#111111), Warm Beige (#DCCAB3), and Soft Ivory (#F7F4F0). Supporting colors include Dusty Pink (#D7B6B6), Muted Mauve (#A88C91), Warm Taupe (#7A6F66), Soft Gold (#C6A64E), and Light Beige (#EDE5DE). Together, these tones create a balance of softness, warmth, and understated elegance.

Typography & Graphic Elements

Arabic typography uses Cairo, while English typography uses Cinzel Elegant. Supporting graphic elements include delicate thread-inspired lines, needle details, flowing curves, subtle patterns, and fabric textures. These components reinforce the identity's connection to sewing, craftsmanship, and soft materials.

09 / 10

Social Media Concepts

Exploring a Consistent Digital Expression of the PRISTA Identity

DIGITAL COMMUNICATION

Content Direction

A nine-post social media grid was developed as an experimental exploration of the brand's potential digital presence. The concepts use a consistent combination of brand colors, typography, product imagery, and minimal layouts. They explore themes of comfort, fabric quality, attention to detail, and seasonal collections. The displayed promotional-style copy and product messages are illustrative concepts, not verified product claims or published campaigns.

10 / 10

Final Outcome

A Cohesive Identity Built Around Femininity and Comfort

PRISTA's visual identity brings together a distinctive P symbol, integrated needle and thread details, refined typography, a soft neutral palette, and supporting graphic elements. The result is a cohesive visual direction that expresses femininity, softness, comfort, and the beauty of carefully considered details.

The final identity was approved by the client without revisions. The confirmed project delivery consisted of the logo files and brand guidelines. The displayed brand applications, website interface, and social media designs are conceptual mockups and experimental explorations, not confirmed manufactured, deployed, or published executions.
